data.body: PS5 CI (run 32059469650): all sub-gates green EXCEPT the default pytest suite, which failed on exactly ONE test — test_prompt_front_matter.py::test_built_in_prompt_round_trips_canonically[plan-review-ac-process-gate]: the packaged reviewer prompt's front-matter was not a canonical fixed point of write_front_matter (the description folded scalar wrapped differently than the writer emits). This test is parametrized over every packaged reviewer .md, so it auto-covered my new prompt; my focused pre-flight suite didn't include it. Fixed by rewriting plan_review_ac_process_gate.md through write_front_matter(*_split_front_matter_raw(text)) — a pure YAML re-wrap of the description scalar, zero rubric/semantic change. 13708 passed / 1 failed -> now 0; front-matter suite 85 passed. Amending PS6.
